name: s-bike-hub
description: Coach from your smart-bike training hub: check-ins, plans, rides, lifting, workouts and training load for bike, run and swim.
long_description: Use the current local Hub through 107 tools: reviewed programs and calendar edits, the plan's load outlook, recorded work rates and report snapshots, validated check-ins and bad-report re-checks, cross-sport training rules, reviewed workout explanations and recorded race predictions. Requires the matching updated Hub app (1.9.0). Athlete files stay local; returned context follows the external AI provider's policies.

hub_url.title: Hub address
hub_url.description: Where the hub runs on this Mac

tools.name: get_activity_report
tools.description: Read ONE imported completed workout with watch observations and existing Hub load estimates.

tools.name: record_activity_report
tools.description: Record the athlete’s explicit effort and discomfort for one imported activity, planned or unplanned, through the normal session-report protocol.

tools.name: get_recorded_swim_draft
tools.description: Read watch-detected pool lengths and strokes from an imported FIT swim into an editable transcription.

tools.name: record_completed_swim_details
tools.description: Attach the athlete’s actual swim sets and coaching summary to ONE imported watch swim, preserving its recorded time/distance/load and avoiding duplicate sessions.

tools.name: preview_strength_workout
tools.description: Parse the athlete’s text with the same deterministic parser used by the Hub creator.

tools.name: preview_sled_effort
tools.description: Estimate TANK M4/MX friction-sled weight equivalent from Torque’s published speed/level chart.

tools.name: get_activity_effort_windows
tools.description: Inspect candidate heart-rate response windows from an imported workout.

tools.name: update_session_explanation
tools.description: Update only a saved workout's plain-language reason for being in the plan.

tools.name: get_coaching_review
tools.description: Read the next 1–14 days of running/lifting outlook, forecast conflicts, holds, symptoms and evidence-based capacity review candidates.

tools.name: preview_coaching_change
tools.description: Preview calendar replacements or an evidence-supported capacity recalibration.

tools.name: apply_coaching_change
tools.description: Apply the exact reviewed coaching draft after explicit athlete approval.

tools.name: get_schedule_adherence
tools.description: Read completion, partial completion, athlete cancellations and missed sessions separately from changes to prescribed targets.

tools.name: get_recent_weeks
tools.description: The athlete's response to the plan, week by week: planned vs done minutes against their available time, each week's phase and shape (build, consolidation, peak_volume, peak_performance, taper, race), hard sessions,…

tools.name: record_missed_session
tools.description: Record why a planned session didn't happen, in the athlete's words (busy, sick, sore, tired, travel, weather, other).

tools.name: get_bike_setup_request
tools.description: When the athlete says 'get my bike working' (or their bike won't connect to the hub): read the bike setup request they queued from the hub's welcome page - the bike's Bluetooth name, services, readable values and…

tools.name: capture_bike_data

tools.name: propose_bike_profile

tools.name: run_bike_check
tools.description: Run the hub's guided check with the latest proposed profile: ~40 s while the athlete pedals steadily.

tools.name: record_bike_feel
tools.description: Record what the athlete felt during the guided check, in their words: harder (the pedals got harder in the middle), no_change, or unsure.

tools.name: activate_bike_profile
tools.description: Make the checked profile the hub's bike - only after the check passed, the athlete felt the resistance change, and they agree.

tools.name: get_training_calendar
tools.description: Read 1–14 days of saved workout prescriptions, actual completions, reports, phase context and projected load readings.

tools.name: explain_training_reading
tools.description: Investigate a reading: implemented formula, constants, source hash, profile inputs, baseline, recorded contributors, planned doses and assumptions.

tools.name: get_running_recovery_review
tools.description: Review the single athlete running recovery time scale, rolling 42-calendar-day evidence, missing/confounded intervals, pooled candidate and validation limits.

tools.name: record_capacity_followup
tools.description: Record explicit delayed recovery 1–14 days after a completed, effort-reported session.

tools.name: get_capacity_review
tools.description: Read estimated goal demands, observed sport exposure, gaps and unresolved symptoms.

tools.name: get_adaptation_review
tools.description: Read progression policy, recent decisions and unresolved localized symptoms before changing workloads.

tools.name: get_program
tools.description: Read the saved macro program, phases and weekly placements.

tools.name: preview_program
tools.description: Preview a draft and optionally compare three starter workload scenarios and forecasts.

tools.name: apply_program
tools.description: Save the exact reviewed preview by draft_id, only with athlete approval.

tools.name: get_progress_evidence
tools.description: Read measured training responses and evidence for improvement; modeled conditioning is not a guaranteed performance gain.

tools.name: get_today

tools.name: get_checkins
tools.description: Recent daily check-ins, diagnostics, verdicts and plans - the trend over days.

tools.name: record_checkin
tools.description: Record or update a day's check-in for the rider (when they tell you in chat).

tools.name: settle_journal_flag
tools.description: Settle a flag the journal raised (get_checkins shows each day's flags: bone, muscle, illness, better).

tools.name: set_plan

tools.name: get_rides
tools.description: Recent rides: date, start, minutes, average and normalized watts, intensity (IF), training load.

tools.name: get_ride_story
tools.description: Everything about one ride (ride id like ride_2026-09-27_0959 from get_rides): stats, time in power zones, highlights, best efforts, records, workout adherence grades per part, streak, fitness.

tools.name: get_fitness
tools.description: Fitness (42-day load), fatigue (7-day), form, advice, the last 7 days' totals and the last 14 days day by day.

tools.name: get_milestones
tools.description: Streaks (days, weeks on goal), lifetime totals, milestones earned and next up.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: The bridge right now: bike connected, live watts/cadence/gear, ERG/workout running, FTP, personal bests (5 s / 1 / 5 / 20 min), this ride's calories and distance, recent events.

tools.name: list_workouts
tools.description: His workouts with ids, notes, time/load/calories at his FTP, and their blocks.

tools.name: create_timed_workout
tools.description: Make a standard timed workout: warm-up 15%, ramp 15%, intervals 40% (split evenly), rests 20%, cool-down 10% of total_minutes.

tools.name: create_workout
tools.description: Make any workout from blocks, each one of: {type:'steady', minutes, pct|watts, label?}, {type:'ramp', minutes, from, to, label?} (pct of FTP), {type:'intervals', times, on:{minutes,pct}, off:{minutes,pct}}.

tools.name: get_load
tools.description: Training load by body system across ALL sports (runs, swims, gym, rides): ENGINE (heart/lungs; watts on the bike, heart rate calibrated to watts elsewhere), IMPACT (feet/bones; running and walking x body weight),…

tools.name: get_programming
tools.description: Programming a swim, bike or run session: the phase (counted back from the next race: base, build, peak, taper, recovery), the rider's load state for that sport (fresh, moderate, heavy but ready, not ready), the tier…

tools.name: set_swim_settings
tools.description: The rider's swim dials: the stroke mix (free, back, breast, fly out of 100), the drill share (15-30%), and whether the mix follows their race (follow_event, default true) or their dials.

tools.name: run_walk_test
tools.description: The run-walk test at 60% of a running plateau: day 1 a short run-walk (about 15 min: 1 min easy running, 1-2 min walking, ~5 min of running; stop if pain reaches 5/10), day 2 how walking feels, day 3 how stairs feel…

tools.name: record_weekly_checkin
tools.description: The Sunday check-in (get_today shows 'weekly' when it's due - Sunday through Tuesday): a look back at the week, asking only about what it held.

tools.name: get_training_block
tools.description: Read the persistent four-to-six-week block, all scheduled sessions including two-a-days, cross-sport demanding-session count, planned versus completed minutes and Sunday advance/repeat/hold/reduce reviews.

tools.name: get_lifting
tools.description: Lifting and functional strength.

tools.name: plan_lift_session

tools.description: The check-off after a gym session, from what the rider tells you: one entry per planned lift, in order ({done, weight, reps, sets, tempo, hold, seconds, failure, why, set_details} - leave out what went as planned).

tools.name: record_lift_followup
tools.description: Two to four days after a lift session (get_lifting shows when one is due): how each region it worked feels now, 1-10 (1 fine, 10 very sore), and how the session compared with the one before.

tools.name: set_lift_rule
tools.description: Add one of the rider's lifting rules, in their words ("No squats", "Favorite lift: incline dumbbell press", "Nothing heavy overhead - left shoulder"), or remove one (remove = the rule's text, or the exercise it…

tools.name: record_swim_activity
tools.description: Attach the rider's report to one imported pool swim: whether paddles or a pull buoy were used and how hard the swim felt.

tools.name: get_routes

tools.description: A saved route's climbs, numbered from 1: where each starts and ends (m along the route), length, gain, average and max grade - for placing climb goals and efforts with set_route_session.

tools.name: set_route_session
tools.description: Attach training to places on a route for a day (default today): when the rider starts that route the bridge runs it, steering auto-shift and shifting for the efforts.

tools.name: get_climb_history
tools.description: Every climb the rider has ridden on a route (or all): date, climb number, length, grade, time, average and max watts, cadence, km/h, VAM (m climbed per hour), gears used - to see progress on the same climb and set…

tools.name: rate_ride
tools.description: Record how hard the rider said a ride felt, 1-10 (session RPE: 1 very easy, 3 comfortable, 5 working, 7 hard, 9 near max, 10 all out).

tools.name: record_morning
tools.description: Record overnight readiness from the watch (COROS: querySleepHrv for HRV + its normal range and baseline, queryRestingHeartRate, queryDailyHealthData for sleep).

tools.name: get_skills
tools.description: The rider's place on each skill ladder (progressions and regressions): cadence habit (rpm range), leg speed, grit (big-gear sets), climb pace (goal time vs their best), running return (walk/jog steps).

tools.name: set_skill_level

tools.name: get_insights
tools.description: The rest of what the watch recorded, cross-referenced.

tools.description: What needs going through with the athlete in the coming week, most urgent first: stop or whole-body warnings, training-rule breaks, forecast conflicts, running deloads and targets, calibration questions, missed…

tools.name: get_race_predictions

tools.name: get_workout_library

tools.name: get_workout_goals
tools.description: Read dated briefs that still need a workout.

tools.name: save_workout_goal
tools.description: Save an athlete-requested dated workout brief with quantifiable sport goals.

tools.name: preview_workout_goals
tools.description: Compare goal quantities with a written prescription.

tools.name: save_library_workout
tools.description: Keep a reviewed prescription without scheduling it.

tools.name: favorite_workout
tools.description: Heart or unheart a library workout by id, or keep an existing scheduled workout by date and index.

tools.name: get_running_response
tools.description: Review selected report-anchored running response, separate feet/legs observations, timing uncertainty, 90-day evidence and validation limits.

tools.name: preview_running_response_model

tools.name: apply_running_response_model
tools.description: Apply exactly the reviewed selected model draft through the normal Hub API.

tools.name: get_workout_imports

tools.name: preview_swim_workout

tools.name: set_wearable_estimates
tools.description: Record the athlete's wearable starting estimates (VO2max, resting and maximum heart rate) for starting capacities before there is training history.

tools.name: get_rechecks

tools.name: record_recheck
tools.description: Record the athlete's re-check answers: pain by site 0-10, stiffness 0-10, walking and stairs comfort (easy/some/hard), any red flags (sharp_bone_pain, swelling, limping, night_pain, numbness).

tools.name: set_body_weight
tools.description: Record the athlete's current body weight (from today, or 'from' YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: preview_report_snapshots
tools.description: Preview the one-time back-fill that freezes each older report (daily/weekly check-in, workout report, lifting follow-up) with the 3-day rate and 28-day carried load it was made in.

tools.name: apply_report_snapshots
tools.description: Apply exactly the previewed report back-fill after the athlete approves it.
